text:
devops-bot: PagerDuty alert fired: PD-INC-8421 - metrics.sparsity.service_prod - severity: P1 - autopage (alertmanager -> pagerduty).

alex (oncall): acked. I'm on it. seeing gaps in prometheus target count and a growing log-ingest backlog.

maya: confirmed — merged a scrape-proxy rewrite earlier this morning (PR: https://git.internal/r/prod/ops/1223). It rewrites target paths for a subset of k8s services. rolling it out now to 3/5 clusters.

alex (oncall): running quick checks:
```
kubectl -n monitoring get pods -l app=scrape-proxy -o wide
kubectl -n monitoring exec -it deploy/scrape-proxy -- curl -sS http://localhost:9115/targets | jq '.activeTargets | length'
```
results: proxy pods healthy, but target count is ~40% lower in eu-west cluster.

pagerbot: PagerDuty notification: PD-INC-8421 acknowledged by alex (oncall). Next escalation in 10m if not resolved.

nico: seeing duplicate alerts — prometheus rule fired and ingest-backlog alert also fired. suspect the rewrite broke some exporters, leading to missing scrape data which then trips pipeline backlog.

alex (oncall): can we mute the duplicate PD alerts short-term? I want to avoid thundering pages while we fix the root cause.

maya: will open an Alertmanager silence for the low-level ingest-backlog alert (10m). command: `curl -XPOST $AM_API/silences -d '{"matchers":[{"name":"alertname","value":"IngestBacklogHigh"}],"startsAt":"'$(date -Iseconds)'","endsAt":"'$(date -Iseconds -d "+10 minutes")'","createdBy":"maya","comment":"temp mute while we triage scrape rewrite"}'`

alex (oncall): doing canary rollback of the scrape-proxy rewrite in eu-west now (kubectl set image on daemonset -> revert to image sha abc123). Pushing rollback.

devops-bot: incidentbot: duplicate pages suppressed via silence id=SIL-8921 by maya.

nico: scaling log-ingest to drain backlog: `kubectl scale deployment/log-ingest -n infra --replicas=10` (was 3). tailing logs shows backlog drain starting.

alex (oncall): verifying metrics flow after rollback: `curl http://eu-west-scrape-proxy:9115/targets | jq '.activeTargets | map(.labels.job) | unique'` -> targeted exporter count back to expected. metrics returning.

lia (support): FYI support — 8 customers had alerting delays tied to missing metrics (tickets #CS-2041, #CS-2044). I'm drafting a short notice.

lia (support): paste for customer note: "We're investigating a metrics ingestion interruption affecting alerting for some customers; mitigation is in progress and engineers are monitoring. We'll follow up with a timeline and root cause." (will send once alex confirms impact window) :email:

alex (oncall): impact window estimate: 09:12 - 09:41 UTC, gap caused by rewrite rollout. Please notify customers with that window.

maya: follow-up fix: update PR to include path-preserve toggle and add unit tests for target rewriting. also adding canary job that verifies exporter paths post-rollout.

alex (oncall): proposed follow-ups: 1) revert rewrite in prod until canary pass, 2) add alert correlation to avoid autopaging duplicates (rules: group by job+cluster, suppress if same root cause), 3) update runbook step to check scrape-proxy targets before rollout.

nico: created quick Jira: SRE-4487 to track remediation and dedupe rule.

devops-bot: PagerDuty: PD-INC-8421 resolved by alex (oncall). Incident closed.

alex (oncall): closing thread. will file a short incident note and schedule a postmortem for tomorrow's blameless review. thanks all for the fast responses :thumbsup:
